goal: Choose cost-aware or fixed240 evidence policy prospectively using estimated autocorrelation from observations 0..109, before the scored continuation at 240..479.
estimator: Trim observations abs(value)>=1.5 in t0..109, linear-detrend retained points via OLS, estimate AR1 by zero-intercept regression of adjacent residual pairs. If fewer than 45 pairs, select conservative fixed240.
selection: If rho_est >= 0.82 choose fixed240; otherwise choose cost-aware from SG030, unchanged. No post-outcome regime labeling.

calibration.disclosure: Calibration used to choose threshold, not independent holdout.

limitations: Predecision samples come from same synthetic realization, though no continuation samples leak.
The estimator assumes a stationary AR-like noise before t120 and trims large observations.
Policy threshold selected on calibration, not externally validated.
No true uncertainty probability or guarantee of universally optimal policy.
